truth: FBA single-reaction deletion growth < 50% WT (independent of every evidence line)

all_lines.verdict: CALIBRATED, MODEST LIFT: confidence rises 0%→28% with agreement (trustworthy); fused AUC 0.99 vs best single 0.98 — value is calibration+coverage.

independent_lines_only.verdict: LIFT WITHOUT CLEAN CALIBRATION: fused AUC 0.66 > best single 0.60, but P(truth) is not monotonic in agreement — rank it, don't quote its confidence.

honest_verdict: PRINCIPLE TRANSFERS, VALUE IS SUBSTRATE-DEPENDENT. The core runs on reactions and reproduces the machinery, but reasoning only ADDS value when several INDEPENDENT informative lines converge. With flux included the fused AUC is 0.99 — but flux is near-tautological with FBA-deletion truth, so that is one line, not convergence. Dropping it, the genuinely independent lines (measured essentiality + topology) reason to only AUC 0.66 — reaction-essentiality is a physics property that measured/topological evidence recovers weakly. Contrast genes, where 5 independent lines truly converge (0.80 > best single 0.75).
